caseName: Bacon & Matheson Forge Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Bacon & Matheson Forge Company v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Alfred A. Wheat, Special Assistant to the Attorney General, with whom Solicitor General Beck and Mr. Randolph S. Collins were on the brief, for the United ■ States. Mr. William H. Graham and Mr. James Kieper for appellants, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed upon the authority of Hill v. United States, 149 U. S. 593, 598; Tempel v. United States, 248 U. S. 121, 130; Horstman Co. v. United States, 257 U. S. 138, 146; Klebe v. United States, 263 U. S. 188, 191; Pearson v. United States, ante, p. 000.
